posts.title:
Milwaukee
[comes back.]
posts.lead: Down 4-0 after the first, the Brewers beat the Rays 5-4 in Game 2. Sal Frelick's homer tied it in the sixth, and Aaron Ashby got the final five outs. Next stop: Tampa Bay.

caption.instagram:
⚾ Down 4-0. Won 5-4.

The Brewers came back on the Rays in Game 2. Sal Frelick's solo homer tied it in the sixth, Cooper Pratt's single put Milwaukee ahead, and Aaron Ashby recorded the final five outs.

Milwaukee leads the World Series 2-0, and it heads to Tampa Bay. Can the Rays answer at home? 👇

#WorldSeries #MLB #Brewers #Rays #allfantasy
